brief.summary_1line: Rama recounts how bodiless Vasistha is reborn through Mitra and Varuna’s seed, while the nymph Urvashi is cursed by Mitra to live among humans.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant nymph Urvashi plays in the waters while the god Varuna watches her with desire from the riverbank.
Varuna releases his fiery vital seed into a sacred vessel created by Brahma as Urvashi stands nearby.
The angered god Mitra curses Urvashi, pointing toward the earth as she stands before him with folded hands.
